step2_3_notes.settings: Own vite server on port 5410 (ratings file in a scratch folder), headless Chromium, tools/dev/audition-level.mjs with the page defaults (room 1, radio filter on) and with --dry (room 0, radio filter off), 27 ids: 17 events5, 4 src_4_shield_*, src_1_hull_1_moss_p1s16, impact_shield_medium, impact_shield_heavy, fold_jump, fold_exit, impact_hull_heavy.
step2_3_notes.chain: engine.ts: voice -> gain -> stage -> room and dry sends -> bus -> volume (0.7 default) -> pre-limiter -> DynamicsCompressorNode limiter (threshold -2 dBFS, knee 0, ratio 20, attack 1 ms, release 100 ms) -> gain that cancels the node's make-up -> analyser -> destination. The overload lamp lights when the output after the limiter reaches 0.999 (-0.009 dBFS) or more.
step2_3_notes.result: Highest output peak of all 27 sounds with the page defaults: -4.1 dBFS, so 2.1 dB under the limiter threshold and 4.1 dB under the lamp. Sounds with a lamp change: none. Energy file>page is -0.1 to +0.6 dB for the one-channel files (the page plays them on both channels, so the level per channel is the same) and -3.0 dB for the two-channel files (not panned); room and radio filter add no level. The four called overdriven leave the page 10.6 to 16.2 dB under the lamp.
step2_3_notes.limiterReductionNotRead: audition-level.mjs does not print the limiter's gain reduction. That the limiter did not act is inferred from the peaks being under its threshold, not read off the meter.

step4.files: assets/audio/render/events5/*.wav and assets/audio/render/source/*.wav (library copies from render/ for the five library events), the copies the page plays. Channels summed; ev5_* are mono, src_4_shield_2 and _4 have two channels.
step4.comparedWith: the four rejected; the two accepted loud-class shields of Stable Audio (src_4_shield_2, _4); the MOSS shield src_4_shield_1 (close, no word on overdrive); the five accepted sounds of the quiet class (hull, valve, -34 LUFS)

measuresThatSeparateInTheLoudClass.whatItMeans: The two accepted loud sounds are Stable Audio shields with 96 to 99 percent of their loud energy under 250 Hz and a tonal spectrum. The four rejected sounds are noise-like with 12 to 35 percent of the energy above 250 Hz (shield_1 25, shield_3 12, fold_jump 33 and 35). The same kind of noise at -34 LUFS was accepted (hull_light_1: 23 percent above 2 kHz; the valves 90 to 97 percent above 2 kHz, flatness 0.14 to 0.18). So the data fit 'noise-like sound at the loud class'; they cannot tell level from spectrum, because in this set the two go together.

step4.otherSoundsTheTwoMeasuresAlsoFlag: In the loud class: ev5_6_shield_bright_2 (flatness 0.563; owner: crackle of a broken cable), ev5_8_fold_exit_1 (0.240; 'too much high-pitched noise', close), ev5_8_fold_exit_2 (0.298; 'breathy, air that is not in vacuum'). All three are noise complaints; none is called overdriven; none is accepted.

verdictDetail.words: The page does not make it: the limiter had no cause to act and the lamp stayed dark. The files are the better explanation, but as sound character (loud, broadband, noise-like), not as clipping: nothing in the files is near full scale in a way that separates them.
evidenceAgainstPage: Highest output peak of the 27 sounds is -4.1 dBFS; the limiter starts at -2 dBFS and the lamp at -0.009 dBFS. The four are at -14.6, -10.6, -15.3, -16.2 dBFS (defaults).
The overload lamp stayed unchanged for every sound in both runs.
Room and radio filter change the energy by -0.1 to +0.6 dB; default against dry the peaks differ by 0.1 to 1.2 dB.
The two accepted shields of the other model leave the page louder (both channels -21.4 dBFS against -21.8 to -24.2) and with higher peaks (-8.9, -10.1 dBFS) on the same chain.
evidenceForFile: The only loud-class sounds he accepted are tonal and under 250 Hz; the four called overdriven are noise-like with much energy above that.
Flatness and the share above 2 kHz separate the four from the accepted loud sounds with factors 3.1 and 4.4.
evidenceAgainstFile: File peaks of the four are -8 to -14 dBFS: nothing is clipped, and the near-full-scale share does not separate (known).
Only two accepted sounds in the loud class, both from one other model and both sub-bass. Spectrum, level or both could be the cause; this set cannot tell.
The same noise-like spectrum at -34 LUFS was accepted, so the file alone is not enough either: the file at the loud class is.
Nobody listened. 'uebersteuert' is the owner's word and what he hears is not checked.

recommendationRound6.a_pageLevelShieldFold: Keep -24 LUFS for shield and fold sounds that are low-end dominated (the accepted src_4 shields sit there). For candidates that the screen below flags, lower the page level by 6 dB to -30 LUFS in round 6, and offer one of them also at -24 so the owner can hear the pair. Reason: the page adds nothing, and the noise-like sounds he accepted so far were 10 dB quieter (-34 LUFS); 6 dB is a clear step that still keeps a shield above the hull class. This is a test, not a result: whether level alone cures it is not shown.

b_screeningMeasure.rule: Loud class only: flag a file when the share of energy above 2 kHz in its loud frames is 0.03 or more, or its spectral flatness (100 to 8000 Hz, median over loud frames) is 0.05 or more.
b_screeningMeasure.margin: share above 2 kHz: lowest rejected 0.039 against highest accepted 0.009 (factor 4.4); flatness: 0.065 against 0.021 (factor 3.1). The thresholds sit between.
b_screeningMeasure.caveat: Two accepted loud sounds only. It also flags shield_bright_2, fold_exit_1 and fold_exit_2 (all rated down for noise). Not usable for hull, thruster or valve: the accepted valves have 0.9 above 2 kHz.

c_notVerified: Nobody heard anything; that the sound is 'overdriven' in the owner's sense is not shown.
The limiter's gain reduction was not read off the meter; inferred from the peaks being 2.1 dB under the threshold.
Headless Chromium, default Stereo stage and default volume (0.7) only; Mono, Headphones and a higher volume were not tried and could change the peaks.
The loud-class accepted set is two sounds of one model, so no measure here is a general rule.
The 6 dB step was not tried.

afterReport.note: Measured after round 6 was made, with the definition of screen.py (loudest 50 ms of the raw cut in dBFS; share of the energy above 2 kHz in the frames within 10 dB of the loudest, 2048-sample Hann spectrum, hop 512), on the raw cuts of all 22 rated MOSS candidates of rounds 4 and 5.
afterReport.meaning: Pressed and noise-like at -24 LUFS was called overdriven four times of four; pressed and noise-like at -34 and -35 LUFS was accepted twice of twice. Level and character go together in this set, as the report says in step 4, so the rule notSaturatedNoise of round 6 is set only for the families that play at -24 LUFS and is no general rule.
afterReport.round6: Over both numbers among the 14 picks of round 6: ev6_2_thruster_mighty_2 and _3 (at -28 LUFS) and ev6_1_hull_light_1 (at -34 LUFS, the prompt of the accepted hull hit).
